name: Deniz Yilmaz
bio:
Deniz Yilmaz's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engineering and a deep-seated love for racing. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering from Istanbul Technical University, he initially worked as a junior engineer for a local automotive firm, quickly distinguishing himself through his meticulous approach and innovative problem-solving skills. His passion for motorsport led him to volunteer at local racing events, where he gained invaluable practical experience.

Deniz's dedication earned him a position within a smaller racing team before Rexal FMI Racing, where he steadily climbed the ranks. He brings a pragmatic approach to the head of operations role, focusing on streamlining processes, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring seamless coordination between all departments. His loyalty and unwavering commitment to the team make him a valuable asset, always striving for efficiency and operational excellence.

What sets Deniz apart is his ability to remain calm and composed under pressure. He’s known for his detailed contingency plans and proactive risk management, which have proven crucial in navigating challenging situations and ensuring the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Deniz is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations and ideas.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Turkish coffee delivered to his office every morning.
